printf "  • Cursor (~/.cursor)\n"
  exit 1
fi

printf "\n${BOLD}INK Skills${NC}\n\n"

info "Downloading from ${CYAN}$REPO${NC}..."
temp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
git clone --depth 1 --quiet "$REPO" "$temp_dir"
printf "\n"

for target in "${FOUND[@]}"; do
  dir="${target%%|*}"
  name="${target##*|}"
  install_skill "$dir" "$name" "$temp_dir"
done

# Local installs (skip if CWD is $HOME)
if [ "$(pwd)" != "$HOME" ]; then
  declare -a LOCAL_TARGETS=(
    ".claude/skills|Claude Code (local)"
    ".openclaw/skills|OpenClaw (local)"
    ".codex/skills|OpenAI Codex (local)"
    ".opencode/skills|OpenCode (local)"
    ".cursor/skills|Cursor (local)"
  )
  for target in "${LOCAL_TARGETS[@]}"; do
    dir="${target%%|*}"
    name="${target##*|}"
    parent="${dir%/*}"
    [ -d "./$parent" ] && install_skill "./$dir" "$name" "$temp_dir"
  done
fi

rm -rf "$temp_dir"

# Save config if any INK config env vars are provided.
if [ -z "$INK_OAUTH_URL" ] && [ -n "$INK_MCP_URL" ]; then
  INK_OAUTH_URL="$INK_MCP_URL"
fi

if [ -n "$INK_API_KEY" ] || [ -n "$INK_WORKSPACE" ] || [ -n "$INK_PROJECT" ] || [ -n "$INK_API_URL" ] || [ -n "$INK_OAUTH_URL" ] || [ -n "$INK_WEB_URL" ]; then
  config_dir="$HOME/.config/ink"
  config_file="$config_dir/config"
  mkdir -p "$config_dir"

  json_escape() {
    printf '%s' "$1" | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g'
  }

  # Preserve existing values from config
  existing_key="" ws="" proj="" api_url="" oauth_url="" web_url=""
  if [ -f "$config_file" ]; then
    existing_key=$(grep -o '"api_key"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' "$config_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -o '"[^"]*"$' | tr -d '"')
    ws=$(grep -o '"workspace"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' "$config_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -o '"[^"]*"$' | tr -d '"')
    proj=$(grep -o '"project"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' "$config_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -o '"[^"]*"$' | tr -d '"')
    api_url=$(grep -o '"api_url"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' "$config_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -o '"[^"]*"$' | tr -d '"')
    oauth_url=$(grep -o '"oauth_url"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' "$config_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -o '"[^"]*"$' | tr -d '"')
    web_url=$(grep -o '"web_url"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' "$config_file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -o '"[^"]*"$' | tr -d '"')
  fi

  # Override with env vars if provided
  [ -n "$INK_API_KEY" ] && existing_key="$INK_API_KEY"
  [ -n "$INK_WORKSPACE" ] && ws="$INK_WORKSPACE"
  [ -n "$INK_PROJECT" ] && proj="$INK_PROJECT"
  [ -n "$INK_API_URL" ] && api_url="$INK_API_URL"
  [ -n "$INK_OAUTH_URL" ] && oauth_url="${INK_OAUTH_URL%/}"
  [ -n "$INK_WEB_URL" ] && web_url="${INK_WEB_URL%/}"
  [ -z "$INK_WORKSPACE" ] && ws="default"
  [ -z "$INK_PROJECT" ] && proj="default"

  # Write config atomically with secure permissions
  tmp_file="$config_file.tmp.$$"
  first=true
  (
    umask 077
    {
      printf '{'
      if [ -n "$existing_key" ]; then
        printf '\n  "api_key": "%s"' "$(json_escape "$existing_key")"
        first=false
      fi
      if [ -n "$ws" ]; then
        $first || printf ','
        printf '\n  "workspace": "%s"' "$(json_escape "$ws")"
        first=false
      fi
      if [ -n "$proj" ]; then
        $first || printf ','
        printf '\n  "project": "%s"' "$(json_escape "$proj")"
        first=false
      fi
      if [ -n "$api_url" ]; then
        $first || printf ','
        printf '\n  "api_url": "%s"' "$(json_escape "$api_url")"
        first=false
      fi
      if [ -n "$oauth_url" ]; then
        $first || printf ','
        printf '\n  "oauth_url": "%s"' "$(json_escape "$oauth_url")"
        first=false
      fi
      if [ -n "$web_url" ]; then
        $first || printf ','
        printf '\n  "web_url": "%s"' "$(json_escape "$web_url")"
        first=false
      fi
      printf '\n}\n'
    } > "$tmp_file"
  )
  mv -f "$tmp_file" "$config_file"
  chmod 600 "$config_file"

  saved_parts=""
  [ -n "$INK_API_KEY" ] && saved_parts="API key"
  saved_parts="${saved_parts:+$saved_parts, }workspace"
  saved_parts="${saved_parts:+$saved_parts, }project"
  [ -n "$INK_API_URL" ] && saved_parts="${saved_parts:+$saved_parts, }API URL"
  [ -n "$INK_OAUTH_URL" ] && saved_parts="${saved_parts:+$saved_parts, }OAuth URL"
  [ -n "$INK_WEB_URL" ] && saved_parts="${saved_parts:+$saved_parts, }web URL"
  completed "${saved_parts} saved to ${CYAN}$config_file${NC}"
